item.vindicator_slayer.vindicator_slayer: Smash attack on falling hits (capped at +10)
Density stacks, effective fall capped at 10 blocks
Smash doesn't knock back the target; more stable relaunch
fml.menu.mods.info.description.vindicato: A sword specialized against raiders (pillager, vindicator, evoker, ravager, witch, illusioner). Deals bonus damage to the raider faction; falling strikes trigger a smash attack (capped at +10). Smash hits don't knock back the target and relaunch stably; stackable with Density (effective fall capped at 10 blocks).
advancements.vindicator_slayer.root.desc: Craft the legendary sword against raiders
advancements.vindicator_slayer.kill.desc: Execute a vindicator with the Vindicator Slayer
